findings.issue: After the first store through the free-memory pointer the text stops knowing the words of the input and overrides structs, though every later store is at mem[64] + k with mem[64] >= 736 (or 416): _input.sysCfg reads as mem[448] instead of _param1, the zero prestates as mem[512] / mem[544], and in the two functions without overrides the dead override branches 'else: _2442 = mem[640]' (l1PAOMultisig and challenger overrides, always zero) are kept around every expectedL1PAOMultisig/expectedChallenger.
findings.rule: Track a lower bound of the free-memory pointer: after mem[64] = e with e >= B (e = ceil32(x) + 736, sizes < 2^64, no wrap), and with mem[64] only growing, a store at mem[64] + k (k >= 0) cannot alias a word below B; such words keep their constant or parameter value, so mem[652 len 20] folds to 0 and the else arm is dead.

notes: The four validate functions (4,700 lines each) were reviewed by their structure (external call sequence, the internalRequire error codes, constants, branch conditions) against validateWithOverrides; they are the same body with different preambles (diff: 215 lines of offsets). Spot checks were exact: SYSCON-10..140 (version hashes, gasLimit <= 500*10**6, scalar != 0, getProxyImplementation == stor6, resourceConfig fields 20*10**6 / 10 / 8 / 10**6 / 10**9 / 2^128-1), isSuperGame as raw in {4,5,7,9,10}, isDevFeatureEnabled(.., SUPER_ROOT_GAMES_MIGRATION) folded to true (correct: hasFlag(f, f)), isRespectedGameTypeValidated, the SCKDG/CKDG/SPDG prefixes, LibGameArgs.decode offsets (vm at +32, asr +52, weth +72, l2ChainId +92, proposer +124, challenger +144 into the struct order of DisputeGameImplementation). The source has no explicit loop: all 687 whiles are implicit: 675 are solc's memory-to-memory copy loop (returned strings, string.concat, ABI encoding of strings) left as while (P7), and 12 (6 per validateMigratedChain function) are the readable ABI decode/encode loops of the address[], struct[] and (uint32,uint256)[] members of MigrationValidationInput. validateMigratedChain(WithOverrides) are exact (input decoding, SharedImplementations stor10, stor11, stor5, stor12, stor13, stor16, stor17, stor20 and SharedConfig stor1, stor0 in source order) but the call to migrationValidator (stor21) is P2. 24 getters and the two string constants are exact; storage names are storN because the getters are not in the signature database. P8: the zero-initialised struct allocations (14-word DisputeGameImplementation blocks etc.) are written and overwritten without being read. P10: each internalRequire leaves a phi with an SSA copy in one arm ('else: _92 = errors').
summary: Faithful where it reaches, but each of the four 4,700-line validate functions is cut off before its end (no return, no final revert), and the text is very obscure: 414 calls with raw-memory arguments, 675 string-copy while loops, struct fields as memory slices, and input/override words read back as mem[448] / mem[652 len 20] with dead override branches.
